content: Customer Vivaan Gupta called agent Anjali Desai to announce he does not wish to renew his home policy, which is set to expire on 05/10/2026. The agent confirmed the policy will lapse automatically after the 30-day free extension ends on 04/11/2026 without auto-renewal. The agent also confirmed that the 10% bundle discount on his auto policy will remain in effect until the home policy fully expires and agreed to email a final expiration notice.

action_items: Mark the home policy as expiring/will expire without auto-renewal
Email a final policy expiration notice to the customer
Ensure the 10% auto policy bundle discount remains in effect until 04/11/2026
